content.ascii:
LocationServiceMap: cached, scoped capability graphs
|
`-- Per canonical Location.Ref: shared by sessions at that location
    |-- Config / Agent / Model / Plugin / Tool / Permission
    |-- FileSystem / Shell / Snapshot / instruction providers
    |-- SessionContext: select + load
    |   |-- -> SessionStore and SessionHistory: coherent projected history
    |   |-- Agent + merged permissions -> Tool.snapshot
    |   |-- Built-ins/discovery/skills/MCP/references/entries -> instructions
    |   `-- Resolved model + instructions + history -> loaded context
    |-- SessionCompaction: shared compaction service
    |   `-- Automatic pressure / explicit control / provider overflow
    |-- SessionModelRequest: request shaping and tool-execution callbacks
    |   |-- History + instructions + model + tools -> plugin-shaped request
    |   `-- -> global SessionModelTransport for session transport binding
    `-- SessionRunnerLLM: implements SessionRunner.Service
        |-- drain: invocation state, not another persistent session object
        |   |-- Await plugin activation; settle stale tools/compactions
        |   |-- advanceToStep -> deliver controls or promote eligible inbox
        |   |   `-- No work: idle hook may admit input; otherwise Complete
        |   |-- -> SessionContext.select + load
        |   |-- runStep: logical-step policy
        |   |   |-- -> SessionCompaction estimate / compact / precompute
        |   |   |-- -> baseTranscript -> context.request.primary
        |   |   |-- Step limit: disable calls, retain tool definitions
        |   |   `-- -> SessionStep.attempt -> outcome
        |   |       `-- Retry/recover/compact/continue/finish; retry reloads
        |   |           context without promoting another inbox item
        |   `-- Location closed or moved -> return handoff to execution
        `-- SessionStep helper: captured dependencies, not a separate service
            `-- attempt scope
                |-- Snapshot capture + event publisher + tool-run records
                |-- Provider stream -> LLMClient.stream; consume to end
                |   `-- publisher -> Bus -> durable session projections
                |-- Local tool call: publish Tool.Called, then fork execution
                |   |-- prepared.executeTool -> Tool.Snapshot.execute
                |   |-- Registry supplies plugin/MCP/code-mode capabilities
                |   |-- Declined permissions/questions remain control failures
                |   `-- ToolOutput.truncate -> publisher -> next-step history
                `-- Settle tools before final step events
                    `-- User stop: cooperative cancellation, then interruption

Reload lifecycle: detach old cache routing and signal shutdown
`-- Borrowed graphs remain alive until handoff/release; scopes free resources
